Tobias Harris appears to be inching closer to making his debut with the Spurs.

An update from Salt Lake City on the 16th-year pro reaching a benchmark in his recovery from a calf injury.

"He's progressing on the court," Mitch Johnson said.

media.title: Spurs' Harris reaches benchmark in recovery from calf injury
media.description: The forward went through a workout on the court before the team's overtime victory in Salt Lake City, coach Mitch Johnson said before the game.

items.title: More from Mitch Johnson on Tobias Harris: "He's progressing on the court. I'll be honest, he did some stuff today (here in Salt Lake City)."
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
More from Mitch Johnson on Tobias Harris: "He's progressing on the court. I'll be honest, he did some stuff today (here in Salt Lake City)."

No clarity, though, on whether the 16th-year pro is at the 3 on 3 or 5 on 5 stage.

items.title: Mitch said Tobias Harris is “progressing, doing some stuff on the court”:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch said Tobias Harris is “progressing, doing some stuff on the court”:

“It’s a tough one. I understand he wants to be out there and he's getting closer and it's just something that we will be unfortunately conservative with. So when he's ready to go, he'll be ready to go.”

Ahead of the official injury report, Mitch Johnson ruled forward Tobias Harris (left calf strain) out for the opener.

There's no timeline for when the 15-year veteran will make his #Spurs debut, but Johnson said his rehab is going well:

"He's ramping up, he's improving, he's progressing."
